name: Otxyn Motion Library
note: Curation manifest: entries are approved *intent*, not shipped implementations. Research candidates remain in research/candidates.json and are never referenced from the website build.

adaptation_authorities.adapt: source licence verified open (MIT/Apache-2.0/CC0) — adapted implementation ships with attribution block
adaptation_authorities.reinvent: source absent/unclear — technique-only documentation; implementation written from scratch
adaptation_authorities.pattern: closed-source demo — documented as design pattern for agent study, explicitly never adopted as code

licence_blocks.MIT: Copyright notice + licence text must accompany any MIT-derived file in library/; MIT adaptation keeps upstream attribution in the entry header comment.
licence_blocks.Apache-2.0: A NOTICE file and the Apache 2.0 text are required; modifications must be marked.
licence_blocks.unknown/unverified: BLOCKED from adoption — read reason in entry block; escalate to the licence owners or re-implement.

fonts.policy: OFL-only. No unlicensed display font is ever bundled. Verified per family against google/fonts METADATA.pb on 2026-11-03.
avoided: Any font referenced by third-party demos without asserted OFL status
GSAP-provided or Codrops-bundled fonts (unknown packaged licence)
Third-party images/shaders/images used by inspiration demos (assets != code licences)

route_tables.escalate: GSAP timeline (licence: GSAP no-charge — do not vendor)
Canvas physics + goo above ~50 moving bodies

verification_checklist: Load demo/implementation at 1440x900 AND 390x844 (Playwright: browser_resize then browser_take_screenshot with scale:'css').
browser_console_messages({level:'error'}) must report 0 errors for both passes.
Screenshot before/after the effect trigger and diff to prove the animation actually fires.
Toggle prefers-reduced-motion (browser_emulate_media) — the effect must degrade to a still frame or cut immediately.
Check frame-budget: rAF loops must use delta-time and not scale work with devicePixelRatio unclamped.
Verify the entry's licence block still resolves to a live licence URL at merge time.

entries.name: Lusion v3 (lusion.co)
entries.description: Award-winning studio site composing a real-time 3D WebGL hero character with scroll-coupled scene transitions, physics-driven interaction and micro-interaction UI throughout. It is coherent because the single 3D scene persists and morphs across the entire page rather than being a one-off hero effect. Winner of Awwwards Site of the Year (Lusion v3) and CSSDA WOTY.

licensing.evidence: Commercial studio site; no public source.
licensing.mode: reference showcase only (pattern study); nothing adopted

adaptation.plan: Lusion v3 — benchmark reference; closed source; documents the persistent-WebGL-scene pattern qualitatively.
